goal:
Small contract follow-ups found in review on 2 Nov. Contract change: deploys only with the revision rehearsal.

SCOPE
- Bound distribution_interval_ns to 10 minutes – 24 hours in Tunables::validate (DistributionIntervalOutOfRange). Today it has no bound, so the owner could set it to years and freeze revenue sharing.
- Emit a tunables_changed event from set_tunables with the changed field names and old/new values, so the admin dashboard can show history.
- Fix the stale doc comment on Tunables::paused ('treasury withdrawals stay open': withdraw_near no longer exists).
- OWNER DECISION PENDING, do not implement until docs/handover-2026-10-29.md records it: should distribute_near/distribute_mpoo reject with Paused while the board is paused?
- ops/keeper (PR #33): raise the default gas for distribute_mpoo to 150 Tgas (it can send three ft_transfer legs plus callbacks).

ACCEPTANCE
- Tests: interval below 10 min and above 24 h rejected; event emitted with the right fields; keeper default asserted in its config test.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md and docs/learning/traps.md.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and docs/backlog.md updated in the same PR.
